name: edge-runtime
description: A server based on Deno runtime, capable of running JavaScript, TypeScript, and WASM services.

issues.title: Early responses to large uploads hang when the relay forwards a cloned request body
Retired user workers are not fully reclaimed — RSS grows ~2.5 MiB per retirement with activeUserWorkersCount: 0 (v1.74.3, policy = oneshot)
Edge Function served code that was never deployed for ~75 min after first deploy (version 1, one deployment id, two regions)
Process-level worker cap and secret revision refresh in per_request mode
`traceparent` header rewritten on Edge Function-to-Edge Function invoke
node:crypto `X509Certificate` methods not implemented — every `@apple/app-store-server-library` verification fails on Edge Functions
Edge runtime's ICU time-zone data predates tzdata 2026e; America/Winnipeg is wrong from 2026-11-01
UserWorker.fetch never settles when a request with a body is rejected before dispatch (WorkerAlreadyRetired)
